woorden.We denken graag met u mee over uw warmte: We are glad to think along with you about your heat demand and the residual streams you have. No obligation.
woorden.Nathan van den Dool bij de geopende comp: Nathan van den Dool beside the opened compost container
woorden.Verwarmt 625 m² kas met gewasafval van e: Heats 625 m² of greenhouse with crop waste from its own site.
woorden.De gewasresten die overblijven na de tee: The crop residues left after growing still hold a lot of energy. The system turns them into usable heat that covers the greenhouse heat demand through the year.
woorden.De kas hoeft zijn teeltafval niet meer t: The greenhouse no longer has to pay a levy to have its crop waste taken away. Instead it goes into the system and delivers the heat that keeps 625 m² of greenhouse at temperature all year round. No gas connection is needed and no heavier grid connection, so the heat supply stands apart from grid congestion and gas prices.
woorden.Wat overblijft is compost die op de eige: What is left over is compost that can be used on site. High-grade compost can make plants more resistant to disease and pests. A growing trial with it is running at the HortiScience Innovation Center.
